author: GamingBolt
description:
The Sinking City 2 is an ambitious rethinking of the first game’s formula that brings many changes to the new Sinking City we’ll explore as protagonist Calvin in an entirely different story and setting. 

Calvin might not be as good an investigator as Charles Reed, but he’s definitely a better fighter, which is good considering this game focuses on surviving a deadly, desolate place while he searches for answers. 

We’ve compiled everything changing from the first game in case you’re interested in picking up a copy; you’ll find this useful even if you’re new to the franchise. Join us as we review the long list of changes Frogwares is bringing to this title.
title: The Sinking City 2 vs The Sinking City 1 - 15 BIGGEST Gameplay Differences

author: GamingBolt
description:
The best he is at what he does, but what he does isn't very nice – if anything describes Insomniac's take on Wolverine to a T, it's this classic quote. Slicing, impaling, dismembering hordes of enemies, stacking up the bodies with no shortage of gore, and yet, beneath it all is a very damaged individual. One who finds solace in his loneliness but respect among those he cares about. And maybe even among those he doesn't, given the sheer number of threats he's cultivated over the years, intentionally or otherwise.

Marvel's Wolverine takes all of that in service of an original story, one that involves Logan venturing across the world to save Mutants from Bolivar Trask. Plot details emerged after the last State of Play, but since then, Insomniac has released not one but two story trailers. The cinematic “Ain't A Hero” trailer offered a montage of locations and bloody battles, from the Reavers to The Hand and Lady Deathstrike. However, it's the story trailer which is far more substantive,
title: Marvel's Wolverine Story - What The HELL Is Going On?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Beast of Reincarnation is so close to release now, and with a few previews showcasing a combat system that immediately brings its inspirations to mind, we thought it a good idea to look into how the game is trying to set itself apart from Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice. Of course, we found many interesting ideas that we just couldn’t wait to bring to you. 

Well, join us for a look into a combat system that could just be something that’s as thrilling as the one-armed wolf’s violent trip across Ashina, but in ways that are entirely its own. The similarities might surprise you more than what’s changing, while those new ideas could make you decide that it’s definitely worth your time.
title: Beast of Reincarnation vs Sekiro - 10 Biggest Combat Differences You Need To Know
